coverage: All non-test web TS/TSX; desktop Rust/FSKit Swift; host shell/reveal Rust. Declarations, adapter hook calls and compile guards are review aids, not proof of registration, reachability, parity or platform support. Rendered values and dynamic controls still require the companion manual inventory.

reachability.scope: Conservative local module graph from every top-level web HTML script, including type-only, lazy, worker/raw-query imports and re-exports. Presence is potential import reachability, not rendered visibility; absence is not a proof of dead code or exemption from parity. Review unresolved paths and runtime injection before excluding anything.
